scope: local HWPX/PDF/web-preview POC; existing service and qualitative pipeline excluded

unified.reference: new local HWPX assembled from SW and physical block definitions; never merge rendered HTML

commonPolarityModule.countFormula: polarity percentage = sum(clauseCount in polarity) / sum(clauseCount in all polarities) * 100
commonPolarityModule.overflow: clone the original-style category block and continue on the next page; never truncate or rewrite an original quote
commonPolarityModule.style: reuse the source template charPrIDRef, paraPrIDRef, borderFillIDRef and picture/table frames

qualityGates: page/structure guard against the selected template
content guard: no unwanted source-company or placeholder remnants
Hancom visual check of page breaks, tables, charts and fonts
PDF is exported only from the finalized HWPX
web preview uses the exported PDF pages

editingContract.webEditTarget: HWPX paragraph, table-cell and style-run mappings
editingContract.rebuild: each saved change re-generates HWPX and PDF
